# `pygeovision timeseries`

A spectral index through a stack of dated images: one mean per image, a linear trend and anomaly flags.
Guide: [Time series](../../advanced/timeseries.md).

## When to use it

Use it to follow a field, catchment or lake through a season or years.

## What you get

`analyze` prints one line per image (index mean and valid-pixel share) and a trend line with R² and p-value;
`anomaly` lists flagged dates.

## Things to know

* Images must be given in **time order**; use `--dates` for readable labels (same number as images).
* A plain z-score cannot flag anything in fewer than 9 images, and a seasonal cycle hides real anomalies: use
  `--method mad` and `--period 12` (monthly) as appropriate.
* `anomaly` needs at least 5 images with data.
* This is one number per image; for per-pixel maps use the pipelines `vegetation_anomaly` and `water_extent_timeseries`.

## Commands

```text
Usage: pygeovision timeseries [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Time series of a spectral index over a stack of images: per-date statistics, trend, anomalies.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  analyze  Mean index per image, in the order given, plus a linear trend.
  anomaly  Flag dates whose mean index is unusual (needs at least 5 images with data).
```

### `pygeovision timeseries analyze`

```text
Usage: pygeovision timeseries analyze [OPTIONS] IMAGES...

  Mean index per image, in the order given, plus a linear trend.

  Images must be listed in time order. An image that cannot be read prints N/A and a warning.

Options:
  -i, --index [ndvi|ndwi|evi|savi|ndbi]
                                  Index to compute.  [default: ndvi]
  -s, --sensor [sentinel2|landsat8|planet|naip]
                                  Band-order preset (positions of red/nir/... in your files).
                                  [default: sentinel2]
  --dates TEXT                    Comma-separated label per image, e.g. 2024-01,2024-02 (default
                                  1..N).
  --period INTEGER                Steps per seasonal cycle (12 for monthly): trend with the
                                  cycle removed.
  -o, --output TEXT               Write the full series (mean/std/p10/p90/valid_fraction) as
                                  JSON.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

### `pygeovision timeseries anomaly`

```text
Usage: pygeovision timeseries anomaly [OPTIONS] IMAGES...

  Flag dates whose mean index is unusual (needs at least 5 images with data).

Options:
  -t, --threshold FLOAT           Score above which a date is flagged (default 2.5 zscore, 3.5
                                  mad).
  -m, --method [zscore|mad]       mad = median-based, robust to the anomaly itself.  [default:
                                  zscore]
  -i, --index [ndvi|ndwi|evi|savi|ndbi]
                                  [default: ndvi]
  -s, --sensor [sentinel2|landsat8|planet|naip]
                                  [default: sentinel2]
  --dates TEXT                    Comma-separated label per image.
  --period INTEGER                Steps per seasonal cycle (12 for monthly): compare like with
                                  like.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```
